title: The Distant Machine Anew
author: Felix Vane
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
